suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-10 adds this relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. Uveitis, including anterior, intermediate and posterior forms, is among documented ocular manifestations reported in patients with Lyme disease. Require Lyme disease or Lyme borreliosis and uveitis to be independently established. Preserve other infectious, autoimmune, medication-related, traumatic, and ophthalmic etiologies. Population-level manifestation evidence does not by itself establish an individual nexus. The cited literature supports only this constrained relationship and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
